functions.source:
SELECT function_name AS name, function_type AS kind, parameter_types AS arguments, parameters AS parameter_names,
      return_type AS result, varargs, stability, has_side_effects AS side_effects, internal, schema_name, alias_of, macro_definition
      FROM duckdb_functions() WHERE database_name='system'

rows.macro_definition: WITH bins AS (SELECT CASE  WHEN ((((NOT (can_cast_implicitly(min(col_name), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)) OR can_cast_implicitly(min(col_name), CAST(NULL AS "DOUBLE")) OR can_cast_implicitly(min(col_name), CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)))) AND (technique = 'auto')) OR (technique = 'sample'))) THEN (approx_top_k(col_name, bin_count)) WHEN ((technique = 'equi-height')) THEN (quantile(col_name, main.list_apply(generate_series(1, bin_count), (lambda x: (x / CAST(bin_count AS "DOUBLE")))))) WHEN ((technique = 'equi-width')) THEN (equi_width_bins(min(col_name), max(col_name), bin_count, CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN))) WHEN (((technique = 'equi-width-nice') OR (technique = 'auto'))) THEN (equi_width_bins(min(col_name), max(col_name), bin_count, CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN))) ELSE "error"(concat('Unrecognized technique ', technique)) END AS bins FROM query_table(CAST("source" AS VARCHAR)))SELECT unnest(map_keys(histogram)) AS bin, unnest(map_values(histogram)) AS count FROM (SELECT CASE  WHEN ((((NOT (can_cast_implicitly(min(col_name), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)) OR can_cast_implicitly(min(col_name), CAST(NULL AS "DOUBLE")) OR can_cast_implicitly(min(col_name), CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)))) AND (technique = 'auto')) OR (technique = 'sample'))) THEN (histogram_exact(col_name, bins)) ELSE histogram(col_name, bins) END AS histogram FROM query_table(CAST("source" AS VARCHAR)) , bins)
rows.name: histogram_values
